name: Doh-Neiiong
instructions: 1. Dry roast the black sesame seeds in a pan until fragrant, then grind them into a fine powder or paste with a little water.
2. Heat oil in a heavy-bottomed pot and sauté the chopped onions, ginger paste, and garlic paste until golden brown.
3. Add the pork cubes, turmeric powder, and salt, and sear the meat until it turns light brown.
4. Stir in the ground black sesame mixture and green chilies, coating the meat thoroughly.
5. Pour in enough water to cover the meat, bring to a boil, then cover and simmer on low heat until the pork is tender and the gravy thickens to a rich, dark consistency.
description: Doh-Neiiong is a quintessential dish of the Khasi community in Meghalaya. It highlights the indigenous use of black sesame seeds, which provides a distinct earthy flavor and dark texture. It is a staple served during festivals and traditional family gatherings.
